title: This 52-week, open-label extension study is to evaluate the long-term safety and tolerability of ACP-204 in subjects with ADP.
official: A 52-Week, Open-Label Extension Study of ACP-204 in Adults with Alzheimer's Disease Psychosis
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the safety and tolerability of long-term ACP-204 treatment in subjects with ADP.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Subject has successfully completed ACP-204-006 study
2. Male or female (age 55 to 85 years old): female must be of non-childbearing potential, male must take appropriate contraceptive method if partner has childbearing potential
3. Subject has a designated study partner/caregiver
4. Subjects are able to complete all study visits with a study partner/caregiver
5. Signed inform consent form with a caregiver or legal representative
Exclusion criteria:
1. Requires treatment with a medication prohibited by the protocol
2. Is in hospice and receiving end-of-life palliative care, or has become bedridden
3. Unstable clinically significant medical condition other than AD
4. Any medical condition that in the opinion of the investigator may affect safety or ability to complete the study
